patches.summary: Adds typed planner commands, Google OAuth/Calendar access, pure scheduling, and safe execution.
patches.reason: The Trello OpenAPI describes one API; the requested cross-API scheduling workflow is API-specific novel functionality.
patches.validated_outcome: Unit tests cover planning, DST, dry-run write isolation, pagination, partial failures, and double-run idempotency.

patches.summary: Uses environment-only Trello key/token values to build the OAuth Authorization header.
patches.reason: Printing Press 4.6.1 emitted cookie-login code and invalid Go quoting for this two-variable composed header.
patches.validated_outcome: Credentials are absent from TOML and token values are never printed.

patches.summary: Adds hand-written card CRUD commands (get, create, archive, move) with typed trello.Service methods.
patches.reason: Generated Trello endpoints expose raw API params; curated commands provide task-oriented UX with confirmation prompts, dry-run support, and consistent JSON output.
patches.validated_outcome: 14 tests pass covering GetCard (found/404), CreateCard, ArchiveCard, MoveCard, ListCards filtering, CLI dry-run, confirmation guards, and API request correctness.

patches.summary: Adds board-aware list/label discovery, label-name eligibility decisions, per-card duration, and move-to-Doing after Calendar success.
patches.reason: The operator's Trello board uses named lists and planner labels; safe weekly planning must discover IDs at runtime, match labels by name, and remain idempotent across Calendar and Trello moves.
patches.validated_outcome: Unit tests cover config defaults/legacy list mode, board and label discovery JSON output, name-based label validation, fail-closed selection policy, dry-run write isolation, live moves, full-rerun move retry idempotency, and partial move failure.
